objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the blind SQL injection weakness of a PHP blog with an admin login and a MySQL 5.7 database and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: When nothing is printed, compare how the page differs between a true and a false condition.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which injection class does the vulnerable query suffer from, given that results are never shown directly?
